candidate_proposition: If a provider selects which expensive cases receive an independent audit under a fixed audit budget, completely truthful audited results can favor renewal when selection excludes cases whose wider effects matter most to the authorization decision.
strongest_interpretation: Independent audit execution is insufficient for independent audit coverage when the beneficiary allocates a fixed budget. Compare risk-stratified externally fixed sampling with provider-selected sampling at equal audit quality.
